title: Enriching automatic test case generation by extracting relevant test inputs from bug reports
read_source: https://arxiv.org/html/2312.14898v2; final publisher copy verified at https://d-nb.info/1372487530/34
datasets: Defects4J 2.0.0. RQ1 studies 809 fixed bug cases and 22,111 bug reports over 17 projects; 7,855 test literals with 1,129 exact report/test overlaps. RQ3 bug-detection and RQ4 coverage experiments use project subsets/recent Defects4J versions; JFreeChart is excluded for lack of report data, and Closure/Math are excluded from some EvoSuite coverage runs.
task: Extract string/numeric literals from bug reports, filter with GPT-3.5 ToT, inject them into EvoSuite’s static input pool and compare EvoSuite/Randoop bug detection and coverage. This is input-value guidance, not root-cause classification or complete report-to-test synthesis.
input_setting: Bug report title/description/comments; Infozilla separates code/text; Javalang parses source-code literals and regex extracts natural-language literals; GPT-3.5 filters candidate inputs; seeded EvoSuite (modified) and Randoop generate tests on fixed code, then tests run on buggy versions.
author_relationship_evidence: Final Springer Data Availability says code/scripts and mined inputs are at anonymous 4Open repository. Author ORBilu profile lists `Dataset: https://github.com/Cwendkuuni/BRMiner`; both routes were checked but neither currently serves the repository (4Open API 401 not_connected; GitHub URL 404). Springer version verified via open institutional mirror DNB and DOI.
source_commit_or_archive: No repository snapshot obtained. Anonymous 4Open endpoint returns 401 not_connected and GitHub Cwendkuuni/BRMiner returns 404; `git ls-remote` to 4Open also reports repository not found. Do not treat EvoSuite/Randoop dependency source as BRMiner implementation.
license: Final article CC BY 4.0. The BRMiner software license is unverified because source repository is inaccessible.
exact_models: GPT-3.5-turbo for LLM filtering/classification, max context 4,096 tokens, temperature 0.7; ToT-style prompt. EvoSuite 1.2.1; Randoop 4.3.1.
Coverage experiments used modified EvoSuite with DSE; three minutes per class and five repetitions; Randoop error-revealing mode.
weights_status: No fine-tuned model; hosted GPT-3.5-turbo API used to filter inputs. No calls made.
evaluation_route: Read full arXiv v2 text (26,434 extracted words, SHA recorded) and retrieved final Springer PDF through DNB (60 pages; PDF SHA and extracted text SHA recorded). Paper’s public-source claim lists code/data in anonymous 4Open; current access fails. Reproduction would need Defects4J 2.0.0 plus Jira/GitHub reports, GPT-3.5 API, EvoSuite fork modified to accept external seeds, Randoop, JaCoCo and 640GB RAM / 48-core EPYC environment; 3-minute/class budget x5. No code/API run.
blockers: The paper claims an anonymous public implementation/data repo, but current 4Open endpoint returns 401 not_connected and git endpoint says repository not found; author profile’s GitHub dataset URL returns 404. No BRMiner source/experimental files were accessible.
Exact EvoSuite modification that injects BRMiner literals into the static pool is not available; using upstream EvoSuite does not reproduce the experiment.
GPT-3.5-turbo filtering requires an external hosted API; no calls or paid spend authorized/performed.
Defects4J/Jira/GitHub report versions and modified EvoSuite/Randoop environment are required; paper used 640GB RAM/48-core EPYC and five 3-minute repeats.

‘Relevant’ is operationalized mainly through exact literal intersection with developer tests after patch; the paper notes patterned/non-identical values may also be relevant but excludes them from this measurement. This can undercount semantic relevance.
The method supplies inputs but does not itself explain causal root causes or produce a standalone test/oracle.
concept_fit: High for extracting report-grounded concrete inputs and comparing project-specific vs cross-project input cues. The bug report input value is an explicit test-generation hint; not a causal explanation taxonomy.
recommendation: High related-work fit for bug-report-derived input concepts on Defects4J: it measures both false-positive/noisy literals and downstream bug detection, with an implicit-input subset. However, do not select as a reproducible baseline until BRMiner source access is restored. Use its evidence that literal/semantic input hints can aid EvoSuite/Randoop, while being careful that reported gains are modest (+18 detections over NoLit in the main EvoSuite AllLitLLM comparison) and exact-match relevance is restrictive.
